<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="glacors" class="pvme-source-title"><ins><nowiki>Glacors</nowiki></ins></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Glacors are profitable monsters that can be fought on or off task effectively, usually for their Slayer collection log items, or due to consistent profit from making </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/881962727705280512.png?v=1" alt="armadylbattlestaff" title="armadylbattlestaff" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and opening </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271452479488.png?v=1" alt="eldertrovewent3" title="eldertrovewent3" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if fought at the Elder God Wars Dungeon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The ability to be assigned Glacors can be unlocked at any Slayer master after completion of Ritual of the Mahjarrat, which also unlocks access to the Glacor Cave.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><ins><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level: 1</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ XP per kill: 4,810</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills/hr: ~100</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal XP/hr: ~481,000</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="desirable-drops"><ins><nowiki>Desirable drops</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Steadfast Boots</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ragefire Boots</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Glaiven Boots</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="location-and-where-to-stand"><ins><nowiki>Location and where to stand</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Glacors can be found at the Elder God Wars Dungeon, Glacor Cave, and Frozen Plateau (Wilderness), but are best killed at the Elder God Wars Dungeon due to dropping </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271452479488.png?v=1" alt="eldertrovewent3" title="eldertrovewent3" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and being generally easier to AFK.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Glacor Front of the EGWD can be accessed quickly using a boss portal leading to Arch-Glacor.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>There are two viable spots to kill Glacors, which each having pros and cons:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/55ufEq0vvx.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ This spot allows for the consistent killing of 2 Glacor spawns.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The long spawn time of Glacors can cause a lot of downtime which may cause issues with maintaining </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/KrGtsWEcVF.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ This spot allows for the consistent killing of 3 Glacor spawns.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This location is more gear/luck dependant as maintaining max KPH requires fast killing of the Glacors and good Enduring Glacyte luck.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Glacytes further North will be killed by some AoE abilities, which may cause them to drop hard to reach </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271452479488.png?v=1" alt="eldertrovewent3" title="eldertrovewent3" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as well as being less efficient XP per Glacor kill while on task.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="afk-magic"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><ins><nowiki>AFK Magic</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Magic is the only viable style to AFK Glacors due to Dragon Breath </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Greater Chain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /><nowiki> being able to hit the spawned Glacytes while targetting the Glacor.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: When starting your hour or killing too slow, you may take the aggro of 2 Glacors at once, be sure to click on the one your character can actually attack, as one will be unable to be damaged</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1" alt="affliction" title="affliction" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1" alt="penanceaspect" title="penanceaspect" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is active.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
